title: P13 — Expose Auritus JSON speech bridge
description:
## Dispatch packet P13
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D06,D07 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
Auritus
Primary paths: cli/src/auritus/speech_bridge.py; features/speech_bridge.feature. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Wrap existing auritus.speech API using D06 protocol, redirect model stdout to stderr, implement readiness/capabilities and offline model checks. No changes to remote content_hash. File linked native Auritus work item before code.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
Gherkin protocol/error/path tests, explicit fake backend tests, make check; real smoke recorded separately.

## Dependencies
videoml-684f74 (P02)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Accepted review correction
D06 correction: recoverable synthesis error is one structured response, process remains alive. Fatal protocol/transport exits nonzero. Test good request, recoverable bad request, then good request in one process.
